senses.gloss: to tear, destroy; to loosen, disarrange; to neglect the hair.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 29:1">Pesik. R. s. 29-30</cite>-30 (ed. Fr. p. 139ᵇ), v. <cite ref="T00927"><he>רָפָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 3:8">Sot. III, 8</cite> <he>האיש פּוֹרַעַ</he> … <he>פּוֹרַעַת</he> Sifra Emor, ch. I, Par. 2 <he>כדרך שבני אדם פּוֹרְעִים וכ׳</he> in the same way that ordinary men (in mourning) neglect their hair and tear their garments; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to uncover. Ib. (ref. to Lev. XXI, 10) [read:] אילו אמר ראש לא יפרע ובגד לא יפרוס יכול לא יִפְרַע ולא יפרום של סוטה ת״ל ראשו if the text read, the head … and the garment …, I might have thought it meant, he shall not uncover the head &c., in the sense in which parʿa is used in connection with the faithless wife (Num. V, 18); v.
units: <cite ref="Horayot 12b:9">Hor. 12ᵇ</cite>. Pesik. Shor, p. 77ᵃ <he>פּוֹרְעִין את ראשיהם וכ׳</he> they uncovered their heads (when the royal proclamation was read, v. <cite ref="Q01713"><he>פְּרוֹסְטַגְמָא</he></cite>); <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 27:6">Lev. R. s. 27</cite> <he>ופָרְעוּ את וכ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 27">Ib.</cite> <he>לא הטרחתי … ולא פורעין וכ׳</he> I have not put you to trouble, I have not ordered you to read the Sh’mʿa standing on your feet and uncovering your heads, but ‘when thou sittest &c.’ (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 6:7">Deut. VI, 7</cite>).

Ḥull. 91ᵃ פְּרַע להן בית השחיטה uncover the place of cutting for them (show them that the animal has been cut according to the ritual); a. e.—Part. pass. פָּרוּעַ; f. פְּרוּעָה; pl. פְּרוּעִים, פְּרוּעִין; פְּרוּעוֹת. Cant. R. to VIII, 4 (ref. to פָּרֻעַ, Ex. XXXII, 25) אין פ׳ אלא נקוב paruʿa means hollowed (made void); Num. R. s. 7 אין פ׳ אלא לשון צרוע paruʿa is a figurative expression for leprous (v.
<cite ref="Leviticus 13:45">Lev. XIII, 45</cite>).
<cite ref="Leviticus 13:45">Ib.</cite> <he>פְּרוּעַ ראש</he>, <he>פְּרוּעֵי ראש</he> bareheaded.
Num. R. s. 19 ונראו כאשה פ׳ and they appeared like a woman with uncovered head; a. fr.—Trnsf. to uncover one’s self for a human need.
Yoma 77ᵃ (ref. to Ez. VIII, 16) שהיו פורעין עצמן והיו … כלפי מטה (מטה euphem. for מעלה) they uncovered themselves and committed a nuisance towards heaven; Kidd. 72ᵇ מפְרִיעִין Hif.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 86">Gen. R. s. 86</cite> <he>שהיה פורע עצמו לע״ז</he> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 145:14">Yalk. ib. 145</cite> <he>פוער</he>), v. <cite ref="Q00191"><he>פּוֹטִינוֹס</he></cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: to uncover the corona, to split the membrane and pull it down.

units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 5a:7">B. Bath. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>הקובע … פְּרַעְתִּיךָ בתוך זמני וכ׳</he> if a person fixes a time (in a note) for his neighbor, and the latter says, I have paid thee within the term assigned to me, he is disbelieved (he is not admitted to an oath); <he>ולואי שיפרע בזמנו</he> (for we say,) would that a man paid his debt when it is due! Ib. 6ᵃ <he>כאומר לא פָרַעְתִּי דמי</he>, v. <cite ref="L00206"><he>לָוָה</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. as ab.
<cite ref="Ketubot 19b:2">Keth. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>אסור … שטר פ׳ בתוך ביתו</he> a man should not keep a satisfied document of indebtedness in his house.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 7:7">Shebu. VII, 7</cite> <he>ועד אחד מעידה שהיא פ׳</he> and if there is one witness against her testifying that it (her dowry) has been paid.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 10:7">B. Bath. X, 7</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78:10">Gen. R. s. 78</cite> (play on <he>פ̇ר̇ת עלי עין</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 49:22">Gen. XLIX, 22</cite>) <he>עלי לִפְ֗ר̇ו̇עַ לך מן אותה העין</he> it is for me to pay thee for that eye (for protecting thy mother from Esau’s lustful eye); <cite ref="Genesis 49:22">ib.</cite> s. 98 <he>עלי לפרוע לך אותה וכ׳</he>; Yalk. ib. 133 <he>עלי לפרוע אותו עין</he>.—

units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 11:7">Num. R. s. 11</cite> <he>כשפ׳ הקב״ה … לא פ׳ אלא יחידי</he> when the Lord punished the generation of the flood, he punished singlehanded (not through several angels).

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 4:2">B. Mets. IV, 2</cite> <he>מי שפ׳ מאנשי … הוא עתיד להִפָּרַע וכ׳</he> he who punished the men of the generation of …, will punish him who does not stand by his word (although the court cannot compel him); <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 3:14">Tosef. ib. senses.gloss: to uncover one’s self (for a human need).
units: Ber. 62ᵃ אין נִפְרָעִין מעומד וכ׳ you must not uncover yourself standing, but only after you are seated (Ms. F. יִפָּרַע עד שישב), v. Pi.

senses.gloss: with מן, to collect payment from; trnsf. to call to account, punish.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 5b:6">B. Bath. 5ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>הבא לִיפָּרַע … לא יִפָּרַע אלא בשבועה</he> he who comes to collect from heirs, cannot collect except on oath. Shebu. l. c. <he>הנִפְרַעַת שלא בפניו לא תִפָּרַע אלא וכ׳</he> she who claims (her dowry) in the husband’s absence (suing the estate), can get it only on oath; <he>וכן היתומים לא יִפָּרְעוּ וכ׳</he> and so heirs cannot collect (from heirs) &c. Ber. l. c. <he>כשם שנִפְרָעִין וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="O01319"><he>סַפְדָּן</he></cite>. B. Mets. l. c., v. supra. Sifra Aḥăré, ch. XII, Par. 9 <he>אני דיין להִיפָּרֵעַ וכ׳</he> I am the judge (having the power) to punish, and can be relied upon to pay reward; <he>אני הוא שפרעתי … ועתיד לִיפָּרַע וכ׳</he> I am he that punished …, and that shall punish you &c.; a. fr.

<cite ref="Sotah 13b:12">Sot. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>בא</he> … <he>ופֵירְעוֹ</he> Gabriel came and unmanned him (used as play on <he>פטיפ̇ר̇ע̇</he>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 145:1-15">Yalk. Gen. 145</cite> <he>בא … וסרסו ופֵרְעוֹ</he>.

senses.gloss: to uncover. Y. Ber. IX, 14ᶜ top לא פי׳ עד שישב he did not uncover (himself) &c., v. supra. Midr. Sam. ch. XXXII פֵּירְעָה את עצמה וכ׳ she uncovered herself and sat down &c.—Part. pass. מְפוֹרָע; f. מְפוֹרַעַת. Ib.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 30a">Ḥull. 30ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>שחיטה מפ׳</he> an open (gaping) cut.
